name: Baked Tofu Rice Bowl with Edamame, Cilantro & Spicy Peanut Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, place oil and spices in a large bowl; stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp turmeric, ground
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu, add to the bowl with the spice paste, and gently toss to coat. Divide tofu between two baking sheets and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until tofu is golden brown, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place peanut butter, soy sauce, water, vinegar, oil, and chili-garlic sauce in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
⅓ cup soy sauce
⅓ cup water
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 medium carrots
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; place on a large plate.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the plate with the bell pepper.
Peel and thinly slice shallots lengthwise; add to the plate and set aside.
Place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide rice between bowls; top with baked tofu, bell pepper, carrot, shallot, edamame, and cilantro. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
